question: Which of the following states has got first of its kind state-level bird atlas in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

 
• Kerala Bird Atlas (KBA) is a first-of-a-kind state-level bird atlas in India.
 
• The atlas, curated over years, covers a number of species found in the State.
 
• It is Asia’s largest bird atlas in terms of geographical extent, sampling efforts, and species coverage derived from the aggregation of 25,000 checklists.
 
• It has details of 94 very rare species, 103 rare species, 110 common species, etc.
